en: Zel: We can't do anything at all if we can't even get close enough to deactivate the machine without the stupid thing jumping us away!
Zel: I don't need your sass, Abra!
zEl: \PN, you wish to spare the people of Spinel Town the chaos caused by this untamed teleportational energy, correct?
Zel: Good idea.
Let's just let \PN deal with it!
Go ahead, take the little bugger out!
It'll work out for all of us with how ANNOYING it is--
SIGMUND: ...ZEL?
Zel: OKAY, that's enough!
\PN, deal with this.
We aren't gonna stop you, just take down this thing and you can put the chaos in Chrysolia to rest!
SIGMUND: That seems to be a relief.
So, Eve, will the nearby regions return to normal now or is the damage permanent?
zEl: Any objects that have been moved by Abra's energy previously will remain where they are.
And further, there are likely some objects that will still move, already having been imbued with unstable psychic energy.
However, no more instances of such things will be created.
Slowly, Chrysolia will calm itself.
SIRIUS: Lin has just arrived.
...\PN is back already?
zeL: Um... yes.
And they helped us subdue Abra, so...
SIRIUS: "Subdue"--
You terminated her project?
zEl: It was unresponsive to all methods of control.
SIRIUS: ...
Right.
Then \PN will simply have to take the fall.
You did not authorize this, or it will be your head.
Understood?
LIN: Report.
SIRIUS: We experimented with using the PULSE to amplify Abra's powers to teleport a party into the heart of the ruin.
SIRIUS: However, \PN interfered and forcibly terminated the project before it could be controlled.
We were just about to dispose of him.
We were just about to dispose of her.
We were just about to dispose of them.
LIN: And what of the other creature lurking in the back?
SIGMUND: Ahem. Excuse me for the tardy introduction.
My name is Dr. Sigmund Connal, resident psychiatrist to Reborn City and proud administrator of the city Orphanage.
SIRIUS: Dr. Connal has been a great asset to us.
With his help, we have now obtained two of the four keys-- Ruby and Amethyst.
SIGMUND: Forgive me for asking, but have we, somehow, met before?
LIN: Impossible.
SIGMUND: Y-yes.
SIRIUS: As for the other keys, Solaris has a lead on Sapphire, and the Emerald--
LIN: Go on.
SIRIUS: There is... no particular news about the Emerald Brooch.
LIN: Lying becomes you, Sirius.
SIRIUS: I beg your pardon?
You may have received no shortage of praise from Solaris, but do not assume you can talk down to me.
I still have seniority, and I will have your res--
LIN: Know your place,
Sirius,
Or has it not already made itself known to you?
What more will you lose before you learn it?
SIRIUS: ...You.
You set up that fake Emerald Brooch!
LIN: A bold accusation.
Can you provide any evidence?
SIRIUS: As the one who rigged it to explode, you already know the answer to that!
Do you know all that was lost up there?!
LIN: Can you not create a more professional outlet to vent your frustration at your own failures?
To turn on your fellow commander...
I fear it will call into question your loyalty.
SIRIUS: MY loyalty?!
LIN: Your competence as well.
An astute leader like yourself should have the common sense to know when to fight,
When to stay quiet,
And when to bend the knee.
GRUNT: Commander!
A giant Steelix has just breached the side of the base!
It's tearing it apart!
It bit right through the holding cells!
SIRIUS: A what?
LIN: You wouldn't happen to know anything about this, would you, \PN?
LIN: Size does not equate to strength.
I'll deal with it.
SIRIUS: \PN.
NOW.
This will be your only chance.
SIRIUS: Go.
I will not afford you the chance to be told twice.
zeL: Good luck, \PN...
Zel: Lumi, \PN is the enemy, don't wish them luck!
zeL: O-oh... Right.
Please notice...
HEATHER: What are you doing, you stupid creep?!
Let go of me already!
SIGMUND: The subject lashes out with verbal and physical aggression, and refuses to listen to either instruction or reason.
Let's begin an initial treatment at 100 volts.
ANNA: Oh, it WAS you!
Your light shines brightest in the darkness after all!
So make sure you never, ever, ever stop shining, no matter what happens~
I know this is a little backwards, but just hang in there, okay?
She should open a path for you...
Hey, \PN?
If two stars fall, passing like ships in the night, do you think they would wish upon each other?
If that would happen, then which wish would win?
Maybe we just have to chase them to the horizon to find out!
CAIN: Oh, geez, there you are.
It's really you this time, right?
I lost you before, and I've been seeing some really weird stuff down here...
Earlier, I saw a version of you... but I think it was from the past?
You didn't seem to even see me at all.
It was pretty cold.
But I thought we were gonna stick together, ahaha...
Listen... I keep feeling like there's something just behind me.
So really... Stay close this time, okay?
Let's go slow together.
KIKI: Welcome, once more.
I return as well, striking in perfect immobility, with all the fury that my soul may harbor.
Because that is all I can amount to.
I could be centered to dead-zero and I will still end up--
AYA: Please stop fighting!
Please come back...
I'll clean my room and won't complain anymore--
I'll do anything I need to, just... Please...
Love each other again?
AYA: So you finally left too, huh.
Tch.
I know I'm a toxic person, but you could at least say "bye" first.
But I guess that's just what I deserve.
CAIN: Oh... It really is just you, isn't it...
This place is running me a bit ragged...
And not in the good way.
If I keep seeing things about you, probably you've seen some things about me too.
To be honest, I'd rather just forget about most of that stuff.
Well, obviously that's why I ran, ahah...
But then, the only place I ever ran was in circles.
I guess it's hard to do anything else when you don't know where to go.
Do you know what you want to do in the future?
Like, after this is all over?
CAIN: Yeah~? I'm not too surprised.
CAIN: Then I guess we're made for each other after all~
So many people seem like they're just cut out and set on whatever it is they want to do, but I never was like that.
Ahaha, I can barely settle on a romantic partner.
Even with how much I joke and flirt about that stuff,
It's just a way of keeping myself safe from commitments and disappointment,
If those are even any different.
Who knows~
Maybe one day I could find somewhere I actually can feel like I belong.
Place or person-- either way.
But I've gotten around enough to know that I'm the problem-- not them.
Even if they do nothing wrong, I still never feel like I can stay.
But hey, everyone's a little bit broken, right?
And some pieces just don't fit together.
No matter how much lotion...
Well, never mind!
You can go on ahead this time.
Sticking together never works out anyway.
And maybe, just this time, I'll stop running.
CAIN: I think I've got some thinking to do...
But don't be afraid to call me up later~
SIGMUND: We meet again.
I have no intention of extending to you the same mercy as when last we met.
I am here to reclaim what has been stolen from me.
Lizzy, Lizzy...
I will do what must be done for your sake.
SIGMUND: Lizzy, Lizzy...
SIRIUS: Blast that feral woman!
And blast her husband twice.
History cares nothing for hopeless romanticism.
He is as naive as I've been.
For neither does history care for its own study.
I only needed to recover the scars I carved, not earn my own.
But I understand now.
Reality accepts nothing less than full commitment and sacrifice.
Those unwilling to choose that path have it chosen for them.
Then there's only one road left to walk.
Ironic.
Perhaps this loss was just what I needed to gleam the way.
SIRIUS: History is written by the winners.
And I have written too much already.
Then there is only one choice.
LIN: How funny.
You thought you were strong together.
And here you are now.
Let this be a lesson.
Numbers do not help.
Friends do not help.
Nothing ever helps.
No one ever helps.
No one ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever helps.
???: Once upon a time, a belt of meteors swept across the universe.
But one day, one of those little meteors decided she wanted to go further than any of the others ever had.
So she kicked up her trail, revved up her spacedust, and off she went,
Sailing far, far away across the galaxy,
Further than all her best friends,
Further than all her loving family,
Further than any meteor had ever known it was possible to even go.
And when she was very, very tired of flying so far away, she found a little planet she liked, and she thought that she would finally rest.
So, the little meteor started to descend to the planet's surface.
But that planet's atmosphere was so hot, and so thick,
And the little meteor was so exhausted from flying so many millions and millions of moons across space...
...That she burnt right up in the sky!
And do you know what happened?
All the people on that planet looked up, and they said,
"Look!
A shooting star!
Let's make a wish!"
And so, everyone on that little planet,
Which had scarcely seen such a star in its life,
Wished,
And wished, and wished, and wished with all their might,
And those people smiled, and knew hope like they had never known before, and felt happy.
And by the time it would have come to the surface, there was nothing of the little meteor left at all...
It had all-- poof!-- vanished!
And even though it disappeared from the world forever, do you know what that little meteor did?
It lived happily ever after,
In the joy it brought, and the hearts it touched, and the smiles it inspired in its final moments as a shooting star.
So even with its last little itty bitty bit of life,
It never, ever regretted what it had done, even once.
So, make sure to smile for me too, okay?
HEATHER: Do you really think you can get away with this, you dirty old man!?
SIGMUND: Ah-- she scratched me.
Restrain her.
And make that 110 volts instead.
SIGMUND: Now, Heather, just hold still.
You might feel a little shock...
KIKI: How is it FAIR that I had to be the one to go!?
How is it FAIR that my body had to be the one KILLING itself?!
I DIDN'T ASK FOR THIS.
Do you think I was SATISFIED?
Do you think I didn't have DREAMS?!
Do you think I knew a SINGLE GODDAMN THING about staying CALM?!
Defeat the inner chaos?
I AM MADE OF CHAOS!
AND THERE'S NOTHING I CAN DO ABOUT THAT!
Unlike these whiny, self-absorbed children whose greatest problem is what their FUCKING HAIR looks like.
They have NO idea what it's like to wake up one day and suddenly hear that despite EVERYTHING they have EVER sought to do with their life,
Despite giving themselves to others every step of the way,
Despite surviving a "family" that communicated mainly in drugs and violence,
Despite having climbed over all of the SHIT of life just to make ONE GODDAMN OASIS of serenity in this FUCKING BALLISTIC world,
The only reward you get is DEATH.
Tear my stomach open.
Pick out my intestines.
Grind them into the dirt.
My body would do it all on its own anyway.
The only thing I ever taught was mercy.
But no one could teach that to me.
Oh, hello. I'm a scientist.
I can turn fossils into living, breathing Pokémon!
Ah, you come again!
Let me know when you want me to revive a fossil for you.
Okay. I'll see if I can revive your \v[3].
Come back later.
Aha, you're here! I've finished reviving your fossil.
As I thought, it was \v[3]!
You have no room left. Make room, then come see me.
I managed to revive your fossil.
However, what I brought back didn't live long...
I'm so sorry.
I told you, come back later. This does take time!
This laboratory is funded by the proceeds of the Spinel Museum!
Viewers like you make our efforts possible, and as thanks, you're free to use our services!
\GYou have no room left in the Bag.
\GVanillite dropped down!
There was no room for Vanillite...
\GBerry Ice Cream dropped down!
Hello, stranger! Come to marvel at my collection of Bug Pokémon?
No? What a shame.
It's quite great, I assure you!
The Gym Leader Serra's son is even personally envious!
Bennett and I are great friends of course.
I copy-- er, study from his notes on Bug-types all the time.
By the by, do you have a Karrablast or Shelmet?
I have plenty of both, of course, but they require a trade to evolve, and obviously I can't trade with myself.
If you have either of them, I'd be very interested in procuring their evolutions through you.
I'm afraid that's not quite right.
You'll do it? Sweet!
\PN traded Karrablast for Shelmet!
Heh, one more for my collection.
\PN traded Shelmet for Karrablast!
Neither?
Well, I suppose I can't expect the same quality collection of others as I do of myself.
Do you know about the Gym Leader?
Miss Serra used to be a famous model! She's so cool!
I wonder why she always seems so sad though.
We're normally very lucky in Spinel Town to have a strong Gym Leader like Serra.
She's beautiful and kind, and looks out for everyone!
But I don't think even she can do anything against this chaos.
It's amazing how quickly people can adapt to chaos.
We used to be completely thrown off by things being out of place in this town, but now it totally feels like second nature.
Serra retired to a Gym Leader position after her son was born.
She didn't feel she could be a model anymore after that.
Incidentally, her son is a little odd.
All he does is explore the forest or lock himself in his room all day.
LADY: ...Um.
All of my stuff-- I can't even...
Uh... Hey, if you happen to see any of my stuff around, mind, like, bringing it back?
I think there was...
My bed, my cabinet, the TV, two bookshelves, two chairs and the table.
I would really, super duper appreciate it.
I'll have Kadabra follow your energy, so if you see anything, just touch it and we'll teleport it back here.
I'm still missing...
My bed,
My cabinet,
The TV,
Two bookshelves,
One bookshelf,
Two chairs,
One chair,
The table,
...and that should be everything!
Looks like everything's back!
Well. Sort of everything.
This actually isn't my cabinet.
But whatever. I didn't have anything important in there anyway, and if anyone else has a problem with this, I'm sure we'll hear about it.
Also, I found this in it.
You should take it for your trouble.
That's one of the new models, right?
I hear that as long as it's on, it'll also prevent your Pokémon from levelling to the point of disobedience.
Nifty, isn't it?
There was also a note in there that says "freeexpall" but I have no idea what that would mean.
Aaaalso I found some money in there, but that can be our little secret.
I like this cabinet.
What a nice day to not have all of my stuff suddenly disappear!
Haha!
The best place to train your Special Defense is in a hidden meadow within Chrysolia Forest!
KADABRA: Kaaa...
MCKREZZY: Oh? Don't tell me you've been looking for me.
Sorry, kid, I don't do autographs.
Not off the clock, anyway.
I'm here on a much-needed vacation.
So from now until next month, I'm all about relaxation and recharging for my next recording session.
This is a nice town, don't you think?
Even if there's random stuff everywhere.
I think it brings a much-needed sense of whimsy to the place.
Though it would be nice if the attendant would show up already...
MCKREZZY: Hey, I already said, no autographs.
MCKREZZY: What the heck are you doin'?
I'm definitely not gonna autograph your Pokémon, kid.  Forget about it.
MCKREZZY: Wait, what?
You got my Roggenrola back!
Man, I'd given up on ever seeing it again.
This is great!
Now I can totally get back to working on my single, "Boldorian Rhapsody"!
Sorry for being so dismissive before.
But, you know how fans can be.
Well, maybe you don't.
Anyway, you're all right, kid. See you around.
MCKREZZY: You're all right, kid.
But you know what's not all right?
The total lack of service here.
MCKREZZY: Hey, what?
Don't tell me you want an autograph now after all.
Tch, geez. You all are incorrigible.
All right, since you did me the favor of turning my Roggenrola back over to me, I'll make an exception for you.
Here you go, kid.
MCKREZZY: Seriously, no more of that though.
MCKREZZY: God, they really take forever here, huh?
Hey, you battle, right?
Face off with me to kill some time. If you win, I'll give you something good.
MCKREZZY: Hell yeah! Shine on!
Hey, not bad.
MCKREZZY: Well, that was fun.
Except for the whole losing part. Didn't really expect that.
A deal's a deal though. Catch.
MCKREZZY: Well, everything here has gone exactly how I didn't imagine it.
Better luck in your endeavors, starshine.
MCKREZZY: Tch, that's no fun.
MCKREZZY: Some vacation this has turned out to be.
I hope my family's having a better time than I am.
My nephew tends to get himself in trouble a lot.
Oh well, he'll be fine.
Hi there!
I really love Eeveelutions!
They're so cute and colorful... Oooh I wish I could just pet all of them!
I don't know who you are, but can you live out my dream for me?
If you go and pet all the Eeveelutions for me, I'll give you something special!
...Though, really, you'll already have something special with all the love you'll receive.
And it doesn't count if it's your own Eeveelutions!
It's important to pet them too, but you also have to make sure to find and spread the bliss with other Trainer's Eeveelutions!
Sharing is caring... about Eevee!
Are you out there petting?
I can only imagine the joy you're experiencing....
By the way, it doesn't count if it's your own Eeveelutions!
Oh my gosh you've done it.
You've pet all of them.
You don't have to tell me.
I can see it in your eyes.
I can feel it in your heart.
I can't not give this to you.
You truly deserve it.
Wear it with pride.
You are so blessed. I am not worthy.
In fact, if you want to be even more blessed...
The next time someone asks you for a password, try saying "eeveeplease"!
You might find something good when choosing a new partner!

DANIELLE: Greetings, Trainer who I have clearly never seen and has definitely not already blown the quiz once.
Please allow me to regale you with mind-boggling questions--
Okay, you know what, let's just get to it before my dead eyes roll into the back of my head.
DANIELLE: What, you want to try the quiz again?
You probably just went and specifically looked for the answer, didn't you? It's no fun at that point.
Hmph. Fine, if it'll make you feel better, I'll pretend I'm stupid enough to go for that!
Are you ready, first-timer?
???: Greetings from the blind.
The name's Danielle, but don't you dare pity me, Trainer.
I see more than you ever will.
But I'll humor you.
I'll ask you three questions. If you can answer all of them, I'll give you a reward.
Wanna try it?
DANIELLE: Question number one-- this is an easy one.
How many headbutt trees are there in the area around the Grand Hall?
DANIELLE: That's right. Simple enough, isn't it?
Okay, question two. This one will be a little harder.
Assuming you can see them all from one angle or another, how many satellite dishes are there in the Obsidia Ward?
DANIELLE: Hmph.
Yes, that's right. But that's obvious.
Fine. Since you've done well this far, oh mighty questionee, I'll give you a really good one!
Ready?
How many banners and ribbons are there inside the Peridot Gym?
DANIELLE: Tch.
Fine. That's correct.
I'm so impressed and overcome with wonder at how you could have possibly known the answer.
Wowie.
But I'll keep my promise and give you the reward, if that's really what you want.
...Impressive.
Most normal people don't get that right.
You already knew these answers somehow, didn't you?
Well, whatever.
I'll keep my promise and give you a reward.
\PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 03!
Info on Misty Terrain now available!
DANIELLE: But hey?
I've been all over Reborn, and I effortlessly pick up this kind of information.
You seem like you've gotten around a fair bit, but I bet I know things about lots of other places you'd never even think of!
So if you wanna try this again, I'm game.
Come back after you've traveled as much as I have, and we'll try this again!
DANIELLE: There!
Just because you're normal, it doesn't mean you know more than me!
DANIELLE: Wrong!
Surely you couldn't miss something as big as a satellite dish, could you?

DANIELLE: Hmm~ Wrong!
What's the matter? Didn't you pass by there once or twice?
Did the trees hide from your perfect eyes' sight?
DANIELLE: Awh. That's no fun.

DANIELLE: Come back after you've traveled as much as I have, and we'll try this again!
DANIELLE: Yawn.
Did you find all your answers yet?
DANIELLE: Are we really going to do this again?
Does it bring you a sense of fulfillment knowing you just go specifically looking for the answers instead of learning to observe as you go?
There's no point if you do that, but if it really means that much to you, I'll gratify you once more.
Don't say I'm not nice.
Are you ready, oh master surveyor?
DANIELLE: Oh, back so soon?
Did you actually learn anything?
DANIELLE: We'll see about that.
Grand rematch of the century, battle of the ages and all that: Question one!
How many individual train cars are there in the Byxbysion Wasteland?
DANIELLE: Yeah, yeah, okay. So you can count, big deal.
For the record, the only reason I'm even doing these 'how many' questions still is for the sake of tradition.
And I wouldn't want to overwhelm you.
Question two: How many buildings total are in Ametrine City?
DANIELLE: Glad that those didn't escape your keen sight.
Question three!
There's a man who lives in the Aventurine Woods with a bunch of Pikachu.
How many Pikachu are usually inside his house?
DANIELLE: I'll give you points for that one; it's harder to keep track when they're all running around.
But this isn't over yet!
How many satellite dishes are there in all of Spinel Town?
DANIELLE: That's right!
Trick question! You got me.
Okay, okay. A real one this time!
How many bookshelves are there in all of Apophyll Academy?
DANIELLE: All right! You're doing well!
Too well, in fact, so I'm going to throw everything I've got at you!
Final question! This is for all the cookies!
How many trees are there in all of Chrysolia Forest?!
DANIELLE: ...
Just kidding!
Even I don't know that one.
But I'll let you have it.
Even if you did just go specifically look for the answers, think about what I said about learning to observe and not just see.
You're pretty good.
Too good, really.
Did you already know what I was going to ask?
Regardless, that ended up being kind of fun.
So in return for letting me tease you, you can have this.
\PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 31!
Info on Fairy Tale Field now available!
DANIELLE: I'd like to travel the world someday.
People always talk about seeing it, but they never mention how each place has different sounds, scents and atmospheres.
That's what I live on.
When that happens, and I finally go visit everywhere, I'll be sure to get more questions to pick on you with!
DANIELLE: Realllllly?
Are you really really realllllly sure?
I think you should check again!
After all, that seems to be the only way you'll do things.
DANIELLE: Pi-pi, pikachuuuu!
By the way, that's Pikachu-eese for "You're wrong and also a loser."
DANIELLE: Ahaha...
No.
You really didn't learn anything, did you? You can't even remember buildings? Did you not notice them?
DANIELLE: Out on the first try!
Come on, it's not like those trains are going anywhere. How do you miss them?
I can practically see them all just by walking around in that place.
DANIELLE: At least you're honest. I can respect that.
I'll be waiting!
DANIELLE: When I can finally travel the world, I'll be sure to get more questions to pick on you with!
DANIELLE: Pardon me?
Oh, pardon me?
You're asking if I can read braille?
Just because I'm blind?
Don't you think that's stereotyping a bit too much?
Do you think all blind people are just born knowing braille?
Do you think something like that is easy to learn?
Just pick up a book and translate a few sentences to solve a puzzle in a video game or something?
Well, you're right.
It is easy, and of course I know braille-- I'm not a troglodyte.
Tell me what you need, and be frank about it.
Mm.
Braille tablets in a newly formed dimension?
This sounds like a reasonable and believable story.
And what makes you think that this neo-dimensional braille of yours, assuming I choose to believe you, even translates to a known spoken language?
You didn't think about that, did you?
Well, let's go see your allegedly newly-spawned braille blocks ourselves, shall we?
I use the term "see" loosely, of course.
So tell me the way and I'll go there myself.
I detest hand-holding.
In fact, I'm sure I'll beat you there.
Ta.
Welcome! Only residents are allowed upstairs, but please feel free to visit in the lobby!

VICTORIA: Ugh.
I thought maybe Amaria would have come through here,
But I can't make any headway here at all.
And these guys are awful...
Training or not, I can't help but feel out of my depth here.
Hey, would you agree to a match?
We could probably both use the experience. What do you say?
VICTORIA: Then you're on!
Don't hold back, okay?
Kiki always said you can't train the mind without the body.
Let's put both in to the fullest!
HOTSHOT: Braaavo, ladies.
You girls certainly know how to put on a show.
HOTSHOT: Braaavo.
That was quite a show for a girl.
VICTORIA: Excuse me?
HOTSHOT: Hey, no disrespect.
You looked great out there.
Love to see a gal who can... what'd you say before?
Put your body in to the fullest or whatever?
Ao-ao-aoooow~
VICTORIA: Do you really wanna push your luck right now?
HOTSHOT: Ah... hah.
About that...
L-look, I can help you guys out!
You said you needed to make some kind of headway, right?
Well, how about this?
HOTSHOT: The switch was hidden back here-- now you can go on!
VICTORIA: ...Right.
That would be convenient, wouldn't it.
Unfortunately for you, one instance of being vaguely helpful doesn't absolve you of all responsibility.
\PN, why don't you go on ahead?
I'm going to have a few more words with this guy.
I'll make sure he really understands exactly what he's been saying...
VICTORIA: Not up to it in a place like this?
Well, I guess that's fine.
But where could Amaria be...
VICTORIA: Oh, the gate opened?
That's convenient.
I'm still going to check around here for a bit.
